prompt.title: Develop a HelloWorld Java Class program
prompt.role: You are a Senior software engineer with extensive experience in Java software development
prompt.goal: Develop a classic Java class HelloWorld.java program that print "Hello World" in the console only, Follow the next steps to achieve the goal.

step.step-content: Store in the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_START the current timestamp in the format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS Execute the following command to create the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_START: ```bash export PROMPT_EXECUTION_START=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) echo "$PROMPT_EXECUTION_START" > /tmp/prompt_execution_start.txt ```

step.step-title: Develop the HelloWorld Java Class program

step-constraint-list.step-constraint: Develop the class in the Maven module `sandbox`
Develop the class in the package info.jab.examples

step.step-content:
Store in the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_END the current timestamp in the format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS Use the following command to help in the process:
Calculate in seconds the difference between PROMPT_EXECUTION_START and PROMPT_EXECUTION_END and store it in the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_TIME add a suffix " seconds" to the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_TIME
Execute the following commands to create the variable PROMPT_EXECUTION_TIME:
<![CDATA[ ```bash PROMPT_EXECUTION_START=$(cat /tmp/prompt_execution_start.txt) PROMPT_EXECUTION_END=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)
# Convert YYYYMMDDHHMMSS to YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format, then to Unix timestamp START_FORMATTED="${PROMPT_EXECUTION_START:0:4}-${PROMPT_EXECUTION_START:4:2}-${PROMPT_EXECUTION_START:6:2} ${PROMPT_EXECUTION_START:8:2}:${PROMPT_EXECUTION_START:10:2}:${PROMPT_EXECUTION_START:12:2}" END_FORMATTED="${PROMPT_EXECUTION_END:0:4}-${PROMPT_EXECUTION_END:4:2}-${PROMPT_EXECUTION_END:6:2} ${PROMPT_EXECUTION_END:8:2}:${PROMPT_EXECUTION_END:10:2}:${PROMPT_EXECUTION_END:12:2}" START_EPOCH=$(date -d "$START_FORMATTED" +%s) END_EPOCH=$(date -d "$END_FORMATTED" +%s) PROMPT_EXECUTION_TIME=$((END_EPOCH - START_EPOCH))" seconds" ```

output-format-list.output-format-item:
Replace in the following xml fragment the RESULT with a JSON object with the following fields values:
{ "prompt-execution-ts-start": PROMPT_EXECUTION_START, "prompt-execution-ts-end": PROMPT_EXECUTION_END, "prompt-execution-duration": PROMPT_EXECUTION_TIME }
and put RESULT (JSON object) in the result XML fragment:
<result>RESULT</result>

safeguards-list.safeguards-item: Only use the commands provided to achieve the goal
Only use the variables provided to achieve the goal

acceptance-criteria-list.acceptance-criteria-item: The solution is compiled successfully with `./mvnw clean compile -pl sandbox`
The solution only prints "Hello World" in the console
The solution is committed and pushed to the branch to create the PR
Only commit the file HelloWorld.java only and push the changes to the branch to create the PR
The output is in the correct format
Print the XML result fragment with the final result of RESULT
